errors.what: Bash tool invoked for PowerShell commands (New-Item/Copy-Item not found in bash)
errors.recovered_by: Switched to PowerShell tool for directory creation and file copy

problems_and_friction: Initial snapshot copy attempt used the Bash tool instead of PowerShell, causing command-not-found errors for New-Item and Copy-Item; recovered immediately by switching to the PowerShell tool. No substantive content issues; all prior analyst data was well-structured and straightforward to build on.
context_understood: Brightline Logistics (40-seat, EU-based) is choosing between Zoho and HubSpot CRM with Zoho consistently favoured on cost, GDPR residency inclusion, and 3-year savings; procurement review needed to solidify contract terms, negotiation levers, and risks before the lead partner assembles the final recommendation.
